## Fix 1 (BACKEND) — Add audience mapper to provisioned Keycloak client

In src/identity/provider/adapters/keycloak/provider.zig:
After provisionClient creates the Keycloak client and the realm-roles mapper (from PR #112), also add an audience mapper so the JWT aud claim includes 'bpm-platform-api'.

Mapper payload to POST to /admin/realms/{realm}/clients/{clientUuid}/protocol-mappers/models:
  {
    "name": "bpm-platform-api audience",
    "protocol": "openid-connect",
    "protocolMapper": "oidc-audience-mapper",
    "config": {
      "included.client.audience": "bpm-platform-api",
      "access.token.claim": "true",
      "id.token.claim": "false"
    }
  }

This is the same mapper pattern already used in the bpm-default realm (see infrastructure/keycloak/realms/bpm-default.json for reference).

Read provider.zig first to understand the existing Step 10 (realm-roles mapper POST) and add this as Step 11 immediately after.

## Fix 2 (FRONTEND) — Increase pipeline test timeout

In web/tests/e2e/pipelines/onboarding-wizard.pipeline.e2e.spec.ts:
Change test.setTimeout from 120000 (120s) to 300000 (300s, 5 minutes) at the top of the test.
